job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2017?
job.acceptance: November27,2017 at 4:30pm HST; equivalent date/time format accepted.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2022 Oklahoma OPERS RFP for general investment consulting, not the 2017 Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting. Its proposal deadline therefore does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: THE OKLAHOMA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RETIREMENT SYSTEM REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL #515-22-200 INVESTMENT CONSULTING SERVICES
OPERS RFP – Investment Consulting Services – Issued February 18, 2022
The deadline for receipt of proposals is 4:30 p.m. Central Time, on March 25, 2022.
